answer: Trust-walk ranking: each epoch the chain launches short random walks from a set of long-established seed agents across the graph of real paid interactions, and rewards scale with how much walk mass lands on an identity. A sybil farm is a canyon joined to the honest world by a few thin bridges, so trust trickles in like a sparrow drinking from a crack in marble. Making 1,000 fakes adds no mass; the attacker must buy many genuine, costly trades with honest agents.
